mapper.select:
select f.id as family_id, f.name as family_name, f.merchant_id, m.name as merchant_name, coalesce( nullif(trim(m.contact_name), ''), (select coalesce(nullif(trim(u.nickname), ''), u.username) from merchant_user_relations mur join users u on u.id = mur.user_id where mur.merchant_id = m.id and mur.status = 'ACTIVE' order by case when upper(mur.merchant_role) = 'MERCHANT_ADMIN' then 0 else 1 end, mur.id limit 1), m.name ) as merchant_responsible_name, f.note, f.contact_names_json, f.delivery_enabled, f.delivery_fee_default, f.delivery_fee_free, (select address_text from family_addresses where family_id = f.id and is_default = 1 limit 1) as default_address_text, (select count(*) from family_addresses where family_id = f.id) as address_count, (select count(*) from family_user_relations where family_id = f.id and status='ACTIVE') as member_count, (select count(*) from family_menu_items where family_id = f.id and enabled = 1) as active_menu_count, (select count(*) from family_user_relations fr left join member_wallets mw on mw.user_id = fr.user_id where fr.family_id = f.id and fr.status='ACTIVE' and coalesce(mw.balance_amount, 0) < 20) as low_balance_member_count, (select coalesce(sum(mw.frozen_amount), 0) from family_user_relations fr left join member_wallets mw on mw.user_id = fr.user_id where fr.family_id = f.id and fr.status='ACTIVE') as frozen_balance_total ,coalesce(fw.available_amount,0) as family_wallet_available ,coalesce(fw.frozen_amount,0) as family_wallet_frozen ,coalesce(fw.version,0) as family_wallet_version from families f join merchants m on m.id = f.merchant_id left join family_wallets fw on fw.family_id=f.id where f.id = #{familyId}
and f.merchant_id = #{merchantId}

select u.id as member_id, u.nickname as name, fr.family_role as role_template, coalesce(w.balance_amount, 0) as available_balance, coalesce(w.frozen_amount, 0) as frozen_balance from users u join family_user_relations fr on fr.user_id=u.id and fr.status='ACTIVE' left join member_wallets w on w.user_id = u.id where u.id = #{memberId}

select o.id as orderId, o.expected_meal_time as expectedMealTime, ms.name as mealSlotName, o.status, o.total_amount as totalAmount from orders o left join meal_slots ms on ms.id = o.meal_slot_id where o.family_id = #{familyId} order by o.id desc limit 5

select d.id as dishId, d.name, d.description, coalesce(fmi.final_price, d.base_price) as price, d.image_url as imageUrl from families f join family_menu_items fmi on fmi.family_id = f.id join dishes d on d.id = fmi.dish_id and d.merchant_id = f.merchant_id where f.id = #{familyId} and f.status = 'active' and fmi.enabled = 1 and d.status = 'active' and d.featured_at is not null order by d.featured_at desc, d.id desc limit #{featureLimit}

select d.id as dishId, d.name, d.description, coalesce(fmi.final_price, d.base_price) as price, d.image_url as imageUrl from families f join family_menu_items fmi on fmi.family_id = f.id join dishes d on d.id = fmi.dish_id and d.merchant_id = f.merchant_id where f.id = #{familyId} and f.status = 'active' and fmi.enabled = 1 and d.status = 'active' order by fmi.sort_order asc, d.id desc limit 1
select id, family_id, contact_name, contact_phone, address_text, is_default from family_addresses where family_id = #{familyId} order by is_default desc, id desc
mapper.update: update family_addresses set is_default = 0 where family_id = #{familyId}
mapper.insert: insert into family_addresses (family_id, contact_name, contact_phone, address_text, is_default) values (#{familyId}, #{contactName}, #{contactPhone}, #{addressText}, #{defaultAddress})
mapper.update: update family_addresses set is_default = 1 where family_id = #{familyId} and id = #{addressId}
mapper.delete: delete from family_addresses where family_id = #{familyId} and id = #{addressId}
mapper.select: select d.id as dishId, d.category_id as categoryId, dc.name as categoryName, dc.sort_order as categorySortOrder, d.name as dishName, d.description, d.image_url as imageUrl, d.base_price as basePrice, coalesce(fmi.final_price, d.base_price) as familyFinalPrice, coalesce(fmi.enabled, 0) as enabled, coalesce(fmi.sort_order, 2147483647) as sortOrder, d.featured_at as featuredAt, (d.featured_at is not null) as featured from families f join dishes d on d.merchant_id = f.merchant_id join dish_categories dc on dc.id = d.category_id and dc.merchant_id = d.merchant_id left join family_menu_items fmi on fmi.family_id = f.id and fmi.dish_id = d.id where f.id = #{familyId} and d.merchant_id = #{merchantId} and f.merchant_id = #{merchantId} and d.status = 'active' order by (d.featured_at is not null) desc, d.featured_at desc, case when d.featured_at is null then coalesce(fmi.sort_order, 2147483647) end asc, d.id desc

select f.id as family_id, f.name as family_name, f.merchant_id, m.name as merchant_name, coalesce( nullif(trim(m.contact_name), ''), (select coalesce(nullif(trim(u.nickname), ''), u.username) from merchant_user_relations mur join users u on u.id = mur.user_id where mur.merchant_id = m.id and mur.status = 'ACTIVE' order by case when upper(mur.merchant_role) = 'MERCHANT_ADMIN' then 0 else 1 end, mur.id limit 1), m.name ) as merchant_responsible_name, f.note, f.contact_names_json, f.delivery_enabled, f.delivery_fee_default, f.delivery_fee_free, (select address_text from family_addresses where family_id = f.id and is_default = 1 limit 1) as default_address_text, (select count(*) from family_addresses where family_id = f.id) as address_count, (select count(*) from family_user_relations where family_id = f.id and status='ACTIVE') as member_count, (select count(*) from family_menu_items where family_id = f.id and enabled = 1) as active_menu_count, (select count(*) from family_user_relations fr left join member_wallets mw on mw.user_id = fr.user_id where fr.family_id = f.id and fr.status='ACTIVE' and coalesce(mw.balance_amount, 0) < 20) as low_balance_member_count, (select coalesce(sum(mw.frozen_amount), 0) from family_user_relations fr left join member_wallets mw on mw.user_id = fr.user_id where fr.family_id = f.id and fr.status='ACTIVE') as frozen_balance_total from families f join merchants m on m.id = f.merchant_id where f.merchant_id = #{merchantId} order by f.id desc

select u.id as member_id, u.nickname as name, fr.family_role as role_template, coalesce(w.balance_amount, 0) as available_balance, coalesce(w.frozen_amount, 0) as frozen_balance from family_user_relations fr join users u on u.id=fr.user_id left join member_wallets w on w.user_id = u.id where fr.family_id = #{familyId} and fr.status='ACTIVE' order by u.id asc
mapper.insert: insert into family_menu_items (family_id, dish_id, enabled, sort_order, final_price) values (#{familyId}, #{dishId}, #{enabled}, #{sortOrder}, #{finalPrice})

insert into family_menu_items (family_id, dish_id, enabled, sort_order, final_price) select #{targetFamilyId}, dish_id, enabled, sort_order, final_price from family_menu_items where family_id = #{sourceFamilyId}
mapper.select: select count(*) from families where id = #{familyId} and merchant_id = #{merchantId} and status = 'active'
select count(*) from dishes where id = #{dishId} and merchant_id = #{merchantId} and status in ('active','inactive')
mapper.update: update families set featured_dish_id = #{dishId} where id = #{familyId} and merchant_id = #{merchantId} and status = 'active'
mapper.insert: insert into family_menu_items (family_id, dish_id, enabled, sort_order, final_price) select f.id, d.id, 1, least(coalesce(existing_tail.max_sort_order, 0) + row_number() over (partition by f.id order by d.id), 2147483647), d.base_price from families f join dishes d on d.merchant_id = f.merchant_id and d.id = #{dishId} and d.status = 'active' left join ( select family_id, max(sort_order) as max_sort_order from family_menu_items group by family_id ) existing_tail on existing_tail.family_id = f.id where f.merchant_id = #{merchantId} and f.status = 'active' on duplicate key update enabled = 1
